findings: A supported report is authenticated but not sent as a rejection.
A failed hash-bound unsupported report reaches only the bounded author repair.
Malformed, missing-listed, changed, duplicate, oversized and symlink receipts stop before the next role.
No receipt is expected for historical or unrelated pre-guard failure.
The complete report stays on disk; the author receives only a concise hash-bound affected-route summary.
limitations: Analytic lifecycle fixtures do not execute a native export, real author or full Studio run.
